title: Issue #159 Sub PR 03 Codex review repair DeepSeek handoff
goal: Codex review에서 남은 Issue #159 Sub PR 03 Producer & Status Why Summary 결함을 모두 수정해 durable runner ledger write, frame/strategy producer correctness, /status.why unavailable semantics, typecheck, tests, verify를 통과시킨다.
allowedChanges: Adjust PaperDecisionLedgerWriterPort so appendFrame returns durable DB frame id.
Make PaperDecisionRunner append evidence with durable DB frame id, not sourceFrameId.
Append evidence even when frame append is idempotent inserted=false so retry can fill missing evidence.
Add the minimal infrastructure/runtime adapter needed to map PostgresDecisionLedgerRepository to the application writer port without importing infrastructure from application.
Make producer group by source frame plus strategy flow and compute category/reasonCounts from group-local trace.
Make evidence fingerprints stable for repeated same-stage, multi-strategy, and multi-order evidence.
Keep ORDER_INTENT_CONVERSION direction based on actual intent direction metadata only.
Represent DB-backed why provider query failure as UNAVAILABLE, not NOT_FOUND.
Update /status schema, ControlStatusSnapshot fixtures, and HTTP tests for why success, null, injected failure, and DB provider failure.
Fix decision-ledger and paper-decision-runner unit tests so typecheck and targeted vitest pass.
forbiddenChanges: LLM summary provider or LLM boundary implementation
Telegram inbound /why or any Telegram command
Live broker wiring or UpbitLiveBroker connection to paper-decision-runner
New POST /v1/orders or DELETE /v1/order call path
Order side effect retry caused by ledger write failure
M19 exit engine, automatic sell, stop loss, take profit, or trailing stop
New runtime dependency or lockfile change without explicit approval
Raw provider payload, raw order detail, Authorization header, JWT, API key, secret key, or query hash exposure
Automatic commit, PR creation, merge, force push, or unrelated refactor

expectedArtifacts.purpose: Runner writer port durable id contract, evidence append retry semantics, and write failure isolation
Frame/strategy producer grouping, group-local category and reasonCounts, fingerprint correctness
DB repository adapter or provider unavailable semantics without changing migrations
/status why schema and provider failure surface
Producer shape, multi-frame, multi-strategy, fingerprint, and why summary coverage
Runner ledger writer integration, duplicate frame evidence append, and failure isolation coverage
GET /status why success/null/unavailable and fixture type safety coverage

handoff: mkdir -p .local/transcripts && npx --yes reasonix run --effort high --budget 1.20 --transcript .local/transcripts/issue-159-subpr-03-codex-review-repair.deepseek.jsonl "Read docs/exec-plans/completed/2026-06-06-issue-159-subpr-03-codex-review-repair-deepseek-handoff.md and fix all Codex review findings for Issue #159 Sub PR 03 only. Work on the existing unstaged/untracked implementation. Do not implement LLM boundary, Telegram inbound, live broker wiring, live order API paths, migrations, lockfile changes, automatic commit, PR creation, or unrelated refactors. Report back in Korean."

corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration/decision-ledger.test.ts tests/integration/migrations.test.ts

git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- src/application src/infrastructure src/interfaces src/runtime | xargs --no-run-if-empty rg -n "POST /v1/orders|DELETE /v1/order|UpbitLiveBroker|createUpbitLiveBroker|submitOrder\\(|cancelOrder\\("

acceptanceCriteria: runner 실행 결과가 decision ledger writer를 통해 frame/evidence append를 호출한다.
runner evidence append는 durable DB frame id를 사용한다.
duplicate frame 재시도에서도 evidence append가 idempotent하게 시도된다.
ledger write 실패는 broker/execution 재시도를 만들지 않고 runner result를 유지한다.
producer는 다중 input frame을 여러 ledger frame으로 보존한다.
producer는 같은 input frame의 다중 strategy 흐름을 섞지 않는다.
producer category와 reasonCounts는 group-local evidence에서 산출된다.
producer evidence fingerprint는 같은 frame/stage 반복에서도 충돌하지 않는다.
order intent conversion category는 실제 direction을 사용하고 order_intent_promoted를 SELL로 오분류하지 않는다.
DB-backed /status.why provider 실패는 UNAVAILABLE summary와 한국어 조치 문구로 표현된다.
기록 없음(NOT_FOUND)과 조회 실패(UNAVAILABLE)가 test에서 구분된다.
ControlStatusSnapshot fixture와 HTTP schema가 why contract에 맞는다.
실제 HTTP status provider test가 why.markets, why.strategies, why.cash, why: null, injected provider failure, DB provider failure를 검증한다.
cost rejection과 risk rejection evidence가 서로 다른 category/reason으로 남는다.
payload/trace에는 raw provider payload, raw order detail, Authorization/JWT/API key/secret이 없다.
기본 PAPER_NO_KEY runtime에서 live order API 신규 호출 경로가 생기지 않는다.
corepack pnpm typecheck, targeted unit tests, ./scripts/verify docs, ./scripts/verify가 통과한다.

reportBack: 완료한 범위와 수정한 Codex review finding 목록
runner writer port가 durable DB frame id를 어떻게 보존하는지
duplicate frame 재시도에서 evidence append가 어떻게 동작하는지
producer가 frame/strategy 단위 category와 reasonCounts를 어떻게 계산하는지
cost rejection과 risk rejection을 어떻게 구분했는지
/status.why에서 why: null, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE을 어떻게 구분했는지
DB integration 또는 전체 verify를 실행하지 못했다면 정확한 이유
live order API 호출 경로를 추가하지 않았다는 scan 근거

risks.risk: writer port를 repository concrete type에 맞추는 과정에서 application layer가 infrastructure를 import할 수 있다.
risks.mitigation: application에는 port contract만 두고 repository mapping은 infrastructure 또는 runtime/test adapter에서 처리한다.

risks.risk: producer grouping 수정이 기존 tests fixture expectations를 크게 바꿀 수 있다.
risks.mitigation: frame/strategy grain과 group-local category를 먼저 고정하고 테스트 fixture를 그 contract에 맞춰 최소 수정한다.

risks.risk: DB provider failure와 no rows를 모두 한 catch path로 처리해 UNAVAILABLE/NOT_FOUND가 다시 섞일 수 있다.
risks.mitigation: query failure test와 empty rows test를 별도로 작성하고 HTTP response readStatus를 직접 assert한다.

risks.risk: full ./scripts/verify가 기존 unrelated failure로 막힐 수 있다.
risks.mitigation: 현재 알려진 failure는 이 handoff scope의 typecheck/unit failure이므로 먼저 고치고, 남는 unrelated failure가 있으면 경로와 이유를 분리 보고한다.
